notes: Adds Suggested Toolbox Talks to Monthly Knowledge Analytics. A suggestion appears only when the same topic has at least two incorrect answers from at least two different people in the selected 3/6/12/24-month period. Existing linked Toolbox Talks are detected and offered for re-delivery instead of encouraging duplicates. Where approved RA/COSHH/SSW source documents exist, Manager/Admin can open a pre-filled Toolbox Talk creator form; nothing is saved, approved or assigned until the manager chooses to continue through the normal controlled-document workflow. Unsupported topics without approved controlled sources cannot auto-create a draft. Role-aware Help gains a direct Go there entry. Includes all v2.10.41 analytics and prior fixes.
